item.title: Update a Bake Sale Sign
item.audience: visitors to a community bake sale
item.prompt_text: Your group sells two kinds of bread rolls at a bake sale. The cheese rolls are gone, but onion rolls are still available. A new tray of cheese rolls will arrive at 12:30. Write a notice so visitors know what they can buy now and what to do if they want cheese rolls.
item.target_grammar: Present simple for availability; will for a planned group action; if for a choice.
item.target_structure: Headline → available choice → next delivery time → friendly instruction.

checklist.point: Say that cheese rolls have sold out for now.
Name the rolls visitors can buy now.
Tell cheese-roll customers when to come back.
